title: Itinera – Least-Cost Pathways: anisotropic movement modelling for archaeology
description: Itinera is a QGIS plugin for anisotropic movement modelling in archaeology: least-cost paths (LCP), least-cost corridors (LCC), From-Everywhere-To-Everywhere (FETE), Randomized Shortest Paths, circuit-theory connectivity, multi-criteria cost surfaces, accessibility / cost catchments, sensitivity analysis, and route validation (Path Deviation Index + buffer overlap). It implements ten cost functions (Tobler on/off-path, Herzog, Naismith, Llobera & Sluckin, Irmischer & Clarke, Minetti, load-aware Pandolf, and wheeled / pack-animal critical-slope presets) plus an interactive map-click tool for point-to-point LCP. Built on the numpy/scipy geostack bundled with QGIS, it requires no external pip dependencies. The pure-numerics core is also published as the itinera PyPI library. Itinera is a from-scratch reimplementation of the core ideas of the R package leastcostpath (Joseph Lewis).
